bio.statement: Banks Post reported in December 2024 that the council appointed Bogroff to finish a vacated term expiring at the end of 2026.

collection_notes: Banks certification letter PDF returned no machine-readable text, and the city's council roster page (cityofbanks.org/meetmayor-council) blocks automated fetch. Incumbency is taken from the City of Banks council minutes of Feb. 11, 2025 (T1), which list Mayor Marsha Kirk and Councilors Peter Edison, Don Giannetti, Marilyn McCalister, Niki Walters, Pearcia Bogroff and Stephanie Jones. Banks Post (bankspost.com, bylined local newspaper by Chas Hundley) is treated as T3. Step 5 searches found no coverage of Banks candidates in the fixed outlet groups. Banks Post (Aug. 2026) calls her the Position CC5 incumbent; appointed Dec. 2024 to replace Catherine Sawyer (matches inventory 'appointed incumbent').
